title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E6 — The Supremes, Willie Tyler & Lester, David Frost
Flip plays a huckster; the Supremes join Flip & Frost for a secret agent and haunted castle skits; Willie Tyler does ventriloquism.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E7 — The Smothers Brothers, Melba Moore
Flips intros his invisible dog; a traveling salesman hits on Melba in the old days and the Smothers Bros join Rev. Leroy’s church.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E1 — The Presentation
Mark is hired as a substitute teacher, but his roommate Robin must teach him how to control his students. Alan Thicke guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E2 — Hangin' With Michelle
Mark injures himself while performing a story for his substitute first-grade class, including Michelle Tanner (MARY KATE/ASHLEY OLSEN). Afterward, Mark is too embarrassed to keep his date with a beautiful woman (GALYN GORG).

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E3 — On The Rebound
Mark's ex-girlfriend, Paula (LELA ROCHON), moves back into town and revives their passionate romance.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E4 — Please Pass the Jock
Mark helps a student basketball player (CHRISTOPHER CARTER) pass an important algebra test. Chris Tucker guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E5 — Cheers
When Mark coaches a girls' cheerleading team, he desperately asks Vanessa to help him train the untalented cheerleaders.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E6 — Warriors, Part I
After Mark finally gets a permanent teaching job as a basketball coach, he's offered a contract to play for the Warriors, a professional basketball team. First of a two-part episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E7 — Warriors, Part II
Mark is given a temporary contract to play professional basketball with his favorite team, the Warriors. Unfortunately, Mark must play guard against basketball star Charles Barkley (HIMSELF). Second of a two-part episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E8 — Torn Between Two Teachers
Mark and Robin try to make Andre choose between his interests in basketball and music.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E9 — My Dinner with Mark
When Vanessa's boss is stranded at an airport, she convinces Mark to impersonate him for an important meeting with an influential businesswoman.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E10 — Miracle in Oaktown
While portraying Santa Claus, Mark helps to make a little boy's Christmas wish come true.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E11 — Unforgettable
Mark helps settle a family fight between Robin and her father, Chip.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E12 — In Vanessa We Trust
After their landlord dies, Mark, Vanessa and Robin try to buy their house for themselves.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E13 — Forbidden Fruit
Mark eagerly dates Teresa (ROXANNE BECKFORD), an attractive schoolteacher, until he learns that her father is Coach Ricketts.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E14 — How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying
When Mark takes a temporary job in an office mail room, he is quickly promoted to an executive position. MARCUS ALLEN guest stars as himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E15 — Valentine's Day Massacre
Robin and Vanessa win dates with handsome bachelors on a television game show while Mark spends Valentine's Day at home.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E16 — Boyz in the Woodz
Mark, Vanessa and Robin take several high school students on a camping trip.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E17 — Boys Don't Leave
Tyler is jealous of his parents' new baby and asks to move in with Mark, Vanessa and Robin.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E18 — The Unteachables
When Mark teaches a history class for lazy students, Coach Ricketts wagers that he can't get them to study.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E3 — Kathryn's Swan Song
Katherine wants to get some attention from Webster and she tries a few things. Meanwhile, Webster's friend is not getting much attention because her mom just had a baby, so she runs away and Webster hides her in his room.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E4 — Consulting Adults
Webster tries out for the football team. Katherine is then afraid that Webster will get seriously hurt especially because of his height and build. Also, we learn that Webster is picked to be on the team only because of George's fame in football.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E5 — Travis
It is revealed to George and Katherine why Travis, Webster's late father, chose George to be Webster's godparents and legal guardians if something happened to them.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E9 — Don't Jump George
Katherine is too obsessed with winning when she appears on a game show.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E10 — A Question of Honor
All the blame goes to Webster when his friends try to rob the Tracadero, their hangout.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E12 — Educating Katherine
Katherine gets a taste of the worst: being a volunteer art teacher. She feels that she is boring and failing, so Webster tries to help her.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E13 — Teddy Bear Scare
George and Katherine both try and persuade Webster that he can do without his teddy bear, which is lost.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E14 — George, The Patient in Spite of Himself
Webster has to have his tonsils out, so he tries to be tough just like George.

S2 E6 — Got A Job
Anxious to become an adult, Brenda (Regina King) takes on part-time work, but soon discovers learning how to juggle all her responsibilities is a full-time job.

S2 E7 — Come Into My Parlor
Brenda attempts to ensnare a boy's affection by inviting him to her Saturday night party, and following Sandra's sneaky suggestion, she tells him the party's on Friday night--but the scheme backfires when her parents go out for the evening.

S2 E8 — The Wheel Of Misfortune
Mary flies out to California to take a spin on the popular game show 'Wheel of Fortune,' but is shocked to discover a smug Sandra as her opponent--much to the dismay of hosts Pat Sajak and Vanna White.

S2 E9 — Washington Affair
Sandra's efforts to win the attention of a famous congressman (Robert Hooks) become muddled when Brenda's art teacher (Jayne Kennedy) catches his eye--yet in her pursuit she falls for another famous personality: Billy Dee Williams.

S2 E10 — Temptations
When Mary (Marla Gibbs) accepts the 'glamorous' title of Chairwoman of the Church benefit variety show, she soon realizes it's really a dirty job and prays for a group like the 'Temptations' to save the show.
